law_name: Law No. 29-2019 of 10 October 2019 on the Protection of Personal Data
jurisdiction: CPDCP (Commission for the Protection of Personal Data; not yet established per secondary sources)
applies_to: Public and private controllers and processors (unconfirmed)
key_requirements: Notification to the Commission and prior authorisation for certain sensitive processing; DPO appointment for public entities or large-scale processing
enforcement_authority: Commission for the Protection of Personal Data (CPDCP) - not yet formally established
penalties_range: Fines of XAF 1M to 100M (secondary sources only; unverified against the text) (unconfirmed)
notes: Published in Journal officiel No. 45 of 2019-11-07; one source gives entry into force November 2020 (unverified); supervisory commission reportedly not yet set up; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
